description: Noise calibration on the current incumbent, with no recipe change. Add an internal salt to the data-order/augmentation generator (the trial seeds stay 0, 1, 2) and run E021 with salt=1. Compare against E021's 0.7552 (salt 0) and log per-seed accuracies. This replaces I028, which was calibrated on E018, now superseded. The margin on the current tip (+0.22 pp) is the binding constraint for every remaining time cut.
